description: Flag a fault as safety-critical when the severity-indicator observation for the underlying event is explicitly safety-critical (e.g. a brake failure to hold under load).

Flag conflicting operating status when two current-operating-status observations on the same asset have been placed under human review as contradictory rather than one being silently preferred over the other.

parameters.reason: Two or more current-operating-status observations on this asset contradict one another.
